inj.note: After reporting concussion symptoms Tuesday, Watson didn't practice Wednesday or Thursday before returning to a limited session Friday and earning a questionable tag ahead of Week 9 action. He then cleared the concussion protocol Saturday. Despite Watson getting the thumbs up from an independent neurologist, head coach Todd Monken already has announced Shedeur Sanders as Sunday's starter, and reports say that Dillon Gabriel will serve as the No. 2 QB this weekend. In the end, Watson is slated to be back in action next Sunday against the Texans.

news.h: Browns QB Deshaun Watson out of protocol but set to be inactive, source says
news.d: Deshaun Watson has cleared the concussion protocol, but a source told that the Browns quarterback is expected to be inactive against the Saints. Shedeur Sanders will make his first start of the season against New Orleans.

news.h: Browns to start Sanders at QB vs. Saints with Watson in protocol
news.d: The Browns will start Shedeur Sanders at quarterback against the Saints as Deshaun Watson remains in the concussion protocol.

news.h: Browns QB Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol; status vs. Saints unclear
news.d: The Browns have placed starting QB Deshaun Watson in the concussion protocol, leaving his status for Sunday's matchup against the Saints in question.
